exposure: women with endometriosis who conceived via ART
women with endometriosis who conceived naturally
cohort: 98 primiparous women with a history of operatively diagnosed endometriosis and a live birth, compared to 300 women without endometriosis who had a live birth
finding: Women with a history of endometriosis had a significantly higher risk of postpartum hemorrhage compared to women without endometriosis.
mod_finding: This study examined the impact of previous endometriosis diagnosis on pregnancy outcomes, finding a higher risk of postpartum hemorrhage and a possible association with preterm birth in women who conceived through assisted reproductive technology.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was significantly shorter in the ART subgroup compared to the no ART subgroup (38 weeks [36-39 weeks] vs. 39 weeks [38-40 weeks]; P = 0.005).
